title: SvgFeSpotLight
responsibility: Renders the native feSpotLight element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeSpotLight.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the native feSpotLight element when supplied. The component calls it with no arguments, and no child block is rendered when it is omitted.

outputs.name: SvgFeSpotLight
outputs.description: The native SVG feSpotLight element rendered by this component, with non-children props forwarded as attributes and children rendered inside when supplied. It adds no wrapper or other feature behavior.
